g.text: Cast / wrought iron: declining stock, older incident pipes

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5e6d76

g.text: Annual records describe operating mileage; incident reports describe pipe age at the time of the incident.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5e6d76

g.text: Left: annual inventories, 1990–2024. Older forms cover 1990–2009; rate comparisons use 2010–2024.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5e6d76

g.text: Right: 722 main reports in 2010–2026; 653 known ages, 69 unknown. Boxes span the middle 50%; whiskers show the full range.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5e6d76

g.text: Numbers are median known ages. Inventory and incident ages describe distinct populations.
